visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot shows a pair of hands holding a khaki-green canvas tool roll bag. The bag is open, revealing various metal camping utensils like spoons and forks tucked into individual pockets. A square patch with a sun-ray design and the text 'Phoenixrise' is prominent on the front. (2) The camera pans to show a display area within an indoor hall where a small metal camping table and a compact fire pit are already set up. A hand points towards the products while the environment shows other exhibition booths in the background. (3) The scene shifts to a person crouching on a concrete floor, demonstrating the assembly of the stainless steel fire pit. He unfolds a thin wire frame and carefully inserts a curved metal sheet into it. (4) The person demonstrates the adjustability of a rectangular metal table. He shows the legs extending and locking into place. The table surface is clean, reflective, and features the brand name 'Phoenixrise' and a product label with pricing. (5) The fire pit and the table are placed side-by-side to show how they align in height and width. A small metal grill grate is placed on top of the fire pit frame. (6) The camera returns to a close-up of the storage bag, showing how the long metal tongs and other accessories are neatly slid back into their designated compartments.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male speaker begins with high-energy narration, introducing the compact storage capabilities. Background music is a low-intensity electronic pulse. Distant crowd murmur is audible. (2) A metallic scraping sound occurs as a metal plate is moved against a frame. The speaker's pitch rises with excitement. (3) A distinct 'thud' and a series of high-frequency metallic clicks signal the unfolding and locking of metal legs on a table. The speaker maintains a fast, conversational pace. (4) More rhythmic metallic clinks occur as the fire pit frame is assembled. The speaker emphasizes technical terms like 'aluminum alloy' with clear articulation. (5) A final metallic impact sound is heard as the grill is placed on the frame. The speaker concludes with an enthusiastic summary of the product's portability.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Feature 1 (Storage) -> Feature 2 (Assembly) -> Feature 3 (Adjustment) -> Feature 4 (Integration) -> Summary
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase the extreme portability, high-quality material (aluminum alloy), and clever height-adjustable design of the Phoenixrise camping gear set for outdoor enthusiasts.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video focuses entirely on demonstrating the specific features and benefits of a single brand's products, complete with brand logos and pricing information.
